text: じっけんに　しっぱい　して　ポケモンと　くっついて　もうたんや　なッ！

structure.jp: じっけんに　しっぱい　して
ポケモンと　くっついて　もうたんや
structure.en: ended up stuck together with a Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: くっついて　もうた
patterns.explanation: てもうた is the Kansai dialect form of てしまった, which says the thing happened completely and you regret it. くっついて　もうた = 'I went and got stuck together'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んや is the Kansai form of んだ, which shows the speaker is explaining how things are. くっついて　もうたんや = 'the thing is, I got stuck together'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て form joins this action to the next one, like 'and'. しっぱい　して = 'I failed, and'.
